symptom: AgentOutputValidator returned a validated_llm with empty facts when unsupported facts were found, instead of throwing an exception.
root_cause: The validator was set to fallback only if unsupported_count > 1, so it swallowed single unsupported facts and returned silently.
patch: Changed max_unsupported_facts_before_fallback from 1 to 0 in src/agent/validator.py.

symptom: VLM escalation was completely ignored when Visual Evidence was required.
root_cause: The _is_structured_sufficient gate returned True for 'visual_ambiguity' by default, stopping execution at the Deterministic level before VLM was even considered.
patch: Modified _is_structured_sufficient to return False if situation_type is 'visual_ambiguity' or 'complex_correlation'.
